How to Get Permanent VIP

1) Copy the email address of the account you used to log in.
2) Open your profile and copy your Secure ID.
IMPORTANT NOTE:
What is a Secure ID?
Your Secure ID is the Android ID associated with your device. It is used to identify your device during account verification.
Compile Hub supports login on up to 2 devices simultaneously. If you want to use your account on two devices, you must provide the Secure ID from each device during verification.
Please keep in mind that a factory reset may change the Android ID / Secure ID of your device. If this happens, your previously verified device may no longer match your account verification.
Don't worry! We provide 2 free reverifications for your Secure ID, provided that you follow the verification instructions given by Modder Hub.
After using your 2 free reverifications, you can purchase another set of 2 reverifications for approximately $1.50 / ₹70 / €2.
Our friendly advice: Please avoid factory-resetting your phone unnecessarily. A factory reset may change your Secure ID and could require your device to be verified again.

After successfully completing your payment through any of the available payment methods below, click the Already Purchased button. You will then receive the exact instructions for what information to include in your email.
